help:
Usage: fulcra-api share create [OPTIONS]

  Create a new share to share your data with other users.

  Examples:

  Share specific data types with a user:
  fulcra share create --name "Research Study" --data-type HeartRate --data-type StepCount --user-id <USER-UUID>

  Share all data types:
  fulcra share create --name "Full Access" --share-all --user-id <USER-UUID>

  Share all files in the /collaboration/context/ directory:
  fulcra share create --name "Context files" --file /collaboration/context/

Options:
  --name TEXT        Name for this share, defaults to authenticated user's
                     name or email
  --data-type TEXT   Data type ID to share. Can be specified multiple times.
  --file TEXT        File or directory to share the latest version of. Can be
                     specified multiple times.
  --user-id TEXT     User ID to share with (can be specified multiple times)
                     [required]
  --start-time TEXT  Optional start time (ISO8601 format)
  --end-time TEXT    Optional end time (ISO8601 format)
  --share-all        Share all data types
  --no-validate      Skip data type validation
  --help             Show this message and exit.
